integrity: The theorem has an explicit self-contained proof and a standalone supplementary exact/numerical checker; no independent validation or publication claim.
scientific_limitations: Requires strictly common sign of all original opinions, nonnegative row-stochastic network and strictly positive alpha and beta.
No claim of global convergence of finite-speed coupled dynamics; no mixed-sign or zero opinion case.
Explicit constants are sufficient and not asserted sharp.
scientific_scope: Same-sign initial opinions in the Alutto et al. March 2026 co-evolving opinion–leadership system; unconditional accessible stationary uniqueness, log-metric two-sided equilibrium solver, global exponential convergence only for fast-leadership reduced dynamics.
title: Unconditional positive-opinion equilibrium and geometric convergence in an adaptive leadership network
